items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 稻妻神里流太刀术皆传——神里绫华，参上！请多指教哦。
items.text_en: Master of Inazuma Kamisato Art Tachi Jutsu — Kamisato Ayaka, present!Delighted to make your acquaintance.

items.title: 闲聊·安定
items.text: 像这样悠闲安稳的时光，如果再多一点就好了…我真贪心啊。
items.text_en: I only wish life could be as leisurely as this a little more often... How greedy of me.

items.title: 闲聊·剑
items.text: 剑，就和茶一样，细细品味才能理解其中风雅。
items.text_en: A blade is like a tea-leaf. Only those who sample it many times can appreciate its true qualities.

items.title: 闲聊·出神
items.text: 这就是旅行者平日里的生活么，呵，感觉又多了解了你一些。
items.text_en: So this is a day in the life of the Traveler... Hehe, I'm learning more about you all the time.

items.title: 闲聊·名刀
items.text: 刀剑抱业，名工怀宝。
items.text_en: A blade embraces its duty as a jeweler cherishes their gems.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 请随我一同避雨吧。
items.text_en: Come with me, let us find shelter from the rain.

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 大御所大人…是在诉说什么吗？
items.text_en: Her Excellency... What is she trying to communicate?

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 「雪霁银妆素，桔高映琼枝。」嗯…美景当前，只差一壶茶与之相衬呢。
items.text_en: "Snow that once adorned the world in silver, thaws to reveal the gleam of the fruit upon frost-laden branches." *sigh* How picturesque! Only some tea would make this setting more complete.

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 风和日丽，要去哪边走走么？
items.text_en: There's a pleasant breeze and glorious sunshine... So, where shall we go for a walk?

items.title: 起风的时候
items.text: 闭上眼睛，向着风吹来的方向…怎么样，很舒服吧？
items.text_en: Close your eyes and face the wind... It feels wonderful, doesn't it?

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早安，旅行者。能像这样在清晨见你一面，我会忍不住觉得…接下来将是顺利的一天。
items.text_en: Oh, good morning, Traveler. ...Whenever I see you in the morning, somehow, it makes me feel like... today is going to be a good day.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 午安。茶饭之后，难免略有困倦。是否有兴致下盘棋提神呢？
items.text_en: Good afternoon. It is normal to feel drowsy after lunch, might I interest you in a game of Go to stimulate the mind?

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 晚上好。夜风舒畅，会是一个良宵呢。
items.text_en: Greetings. An auspicious breeze blows this evening. Tonight will be peaceful.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 「若知是梦何须醒，不比真如一相会。」
items.text_en: "Was it one's thoughts that drew him to my dreams? Had I known it a dream, one would not have awakened." Hehe, I love that poem.

items.title: 关于绫华自己·社奉行
items.text: 「稻妻幕府社奉行神里家」，位于稻妻名门中的笔头之格位。作为三奉行之一，掌管祭祀活动与人文艺术。自从双亲过世之后，族内的大小事务，便由兄长和我承担了。
items.text_en: "Inazuma Shogunate, Yashiro Commission, Kamisato Clan." Widely known as one of the most distinguished clans in all of Inazuma, it is the branch of the Tri-Commission that manages ceremonial and cultural affairs. Since my parents passed, Brother and I assumed responsibility for all clan matters, big and small.

items.title: 关于绫华自己·地位
items.text: 很多人因为我是「白鹭公主」，是社奉行神里家的大小姐而敬重我。他们所敬重的，只是我所身处的地位，与绫华我是怎样的人并无关系…所以我想，能真正走近我的，或许只有…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Many look up to me as the Shirasagi Himegimi and as the daughter of the Kamisato Clan. But the object of their respect has everything to do with my position, and nothing at all to do with me, Ayaka. It makes me think that... maybe, there is only one person I know who is truly able to get close to me...

items.title: 关于绫华自己·愿望
items.text: 如今的我，依旧想成为值得大家信任的人。不过，鼓舞我的原因，已不再是肩上的责任或他人的期待。而是因为，你也是这样的人啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Today, as in the past, I aspire to be somebody whom everyone can trust. But what motivates me is no longer the responsibilities I shoulder, or the expectations of other people. Rather, it is the fact that you are this kind of person, too.

items.title: 关于我们·茶室
items.text: 如你有空，我们移步木漏茶室如何？在这样恬静的日子，略加交流茶艺心得，想来是颇具雅趣的。
items.text_en: If you've got time, shall we take a walk to Komore Teahouse? To chat about the art of tea on a pleasant day like this seems like the sophisticated thing to do.

items.title: 关于我们·节日
items.text: 如果有机会的话，我想试着和你共度异国的节日。需要遵循的当地风俗、礼仪规范，还有伴手礼的推荐，可以麻烦你…一一指导我吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "The Whispers of the Crane and the White Rabbit"If I ever have the chance, I would very much like to experience the festivities of another nation with you one day. Though, I will need some guidance on local customs and etiquette, and advice on what gifts to bring... Could I trouble you to give me some guidance?

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 「神之眼」，即是胸怀大志之人所获的印绶。如果问我有什么志向的话…这个还是保密吧，只是一个微不足道的梦想罢了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Visions are a seal of approval for those who are most ambitious. As for my own ambitions, they shall remain private for now. It is nothing more than an insignificant dream.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 试问，常说「禅茶一味」，又说「剑禅一如」，那么剑和茶，又是什么关系呢？
items.text_en: It is said that "the flavor of Zen is that of tea," and it is also said that "the power of Zen is that of the blade." One might then ask: What does that say about the relationship between tea and the blade?

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 你在城中，见过枯萎的樱花树么？这种「枯」之美，让我想到春天盛开之景。不过别人似乎并不这么想，不再开花的樱树会被移走…就算一次也好，真想看到它再次开放。
items.text_en: Have you ever noticed the withering sakura tree in the city? For me, there is a beauty to the withering, it brings back fond memories of the spring. Most people don't agree — sakura trees that will never bloom again are removed. But when I look at a tree, all I want is to see it blossom again... just one more time...

items.title: 关于托马
items.text: 托马是我很重要的朋友，他的开朗和阳光总是感染着我。某种意义上来说，他就像是我的另一个兄长一样，已经成为了「神里家」的一员。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Thoma is a dear friend. He always lifts my spirits with his sunny disposition. In a sense, I think of him as another brother, and as a full member of the Kamisato Clan.

items.title: 关于九条裟罗
items.text: 为「天领奉行」工作的九条裟罗…她总是一脸严肃。我和她曾经起过几次争端，不过她本质是忠义之士，这点无可否认。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Kujou Sara of the Tenryou Commission is... not known to smile, and I have had my fair share of disputes with her. She is, however, a loyal servant to Inazuma, there is no question about that.

items.title: 关于鹿野院平藏
items.text: 鹿野院先生？他和九条小姐一样，是「天领奉行」的人。他…也是一个很有原则的人。对于这些「原则」的坚持，甚至比九条小姐更执着。只不过，什么事应该被算在这些「原则」之内，我想，或许只有鹿野院先生自己知道吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Mr. Shikanoin belongs to the Tenryou Commission, just like Miss Kujou. He is very... principled, sometimes even more determinedly so than Miss Kujou. The only thing is, when it comes to the question of which matters should be governed by his principles, I believe only Mr. Shikanoin himself knows the answer...

items.title: 关于早柚
items.text: 早柚这孩子，最近有没有给你添什么麻烦呢？如果看见她偷懒，可以直接告诉我。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Ah, little Sayu. She hasn't been causing you any trouble lately, has she? Hehe, if you ever notice her slacking off, please let me know.

items.title: 关于雷电将军·猜测
items.text: 对大御所大人的看法吗？这并不该由我等下属随意议论。但…将军大人她，在追求「永恒」之路上，可能也很孤独吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The Almighty Shogun? It would be improper of me to comment, given that I am one of her subjects. All I will say is that... I think that Her Excellency must get lonely on the road to eternity.

items.title: 关于雷电将军·立场
items.text: 见证了「无想的一刀」并且活了下来，该说是堪称伟业的经历了吧。虽然对我来说，她是真正的神明，一念之间可以更改稻妻的命运，但如果是和你起了冲突的话…我一定会站在你这一边的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"To witness the Musou no Hitotachi and live to tell the tale is quite a remarkable feat. Even though I recognize her as our true deity with the power to change Inazuma's fate at will, if there is conflict between the two of you, then... I shall choose to side with you.

items.title: 关于八重神子
items.text: 我和八重宫司大人的合作向来很愉快。你看，操办节庆庆典非常劳神费力，营收多半也不好看。但是八重宫司大人操办的产业，真的既风雅又有收成。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I have always greatly enjoyed working with Guuji Yae. Organizing festival affairs generally takes a lot of effort and doesn't generate much income, but Guuji Yae's events always come off both elegant and profitable.

items.title: 关于神里绫人
items.text: 作为神里家的家主，兄长平日需要出面诸多场合。我虽尽力分担兄长肩上所负担的责任，却也无法缓和他常年积压在身的疲倦。唉，就当是为了妹妹着想，希望你能劝言，让兄长多多注意身体啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4As the head of the Kamisato Clan, brother always has a full schedule of places he needs to be. I do try my best to share his load, but there is no changing the pressure he is subjected to all year round, and the toll it takes upon him. *sigh* If you see him, remind him to take care of himself, for his sister's sake...

items.title: 关于宵宫
items.text: 操办节庆庆典是社奉行和巫女众的责任，那位烟火专家也的确能让气氛热烈起来，彼此合作多了，因而渐渐熟络。嗯？治安和消防问题吗？我们也会一并纳入预先规划的。因为这些原因而看不到烟花，才会让人们心中留下缺憾吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The Yashiro Commission and the shrine maidens are responsible for festival affairs, and Yoimiya, as a fireworks expert, knows how to create an atmosphere. So we have become well acquainted with her over the years.Hmm? Public order and fire prevention? We factor these concerns in well in advance during the planning stage. To deny people the chance to see fireworks simply for these reasons would leave them feeling very disappointed.

items.title: 想要了解绫华·其一
items.text: 你的请求，对我来说很特别呢。既然把你当做朋友，我也应坦诚以待。不过，事关神里家的秘密，还希望你能守口如瓶。
items.text_en: Complete "Stillness, the Sublimation of Shadow"Your request is quite unusual for me. Since I see you as a friend, it would only be fair to be open and honest with you, but if this means sharing secrets of the Kamisato Clan... I would ask that you keep anything I tell you in strict confidence.

items.title: 想要了解绫华·其二
items.text: 曾经，神里家因为没能保护好国宝级别的刀工，遭受了不小的冲击。受愚人众阴谋算计，我们折损了诸多臣下，受到许多责罚。父亲甚至因之早衰，神里家在幕府中的地位也一落千丈…好在兄长继任后力挽狂澜。不过，家门虽已复兴，社奉行一系也上下齐心，但大事要事方面，仍靠兄长定夺。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Complete "Stillness, the Sublimation of Shadow"The Kamisato Clan once suffered a major blow when we failed to protect a swordsmith of national significance. We were harassed by the Fatui, we lost many of our people, and we received a great deal of criticism. It all aged Father greatly, and severely damaged the Kamisato Clan's standing within the Shogunate. Brother has worked tirelessly to reverse the trend since he assumed leadership, but although our clan's position is now restored and the Yashiro Commission is unified once more, we still rely on Brother to make the decisions on all matters of any importance.

items.title: 想要了解绫华·其三
items.text: 将军所传的锻刀之术，也因星象、用途、矿质、炉火环境、人之性格、元素变化的不同，而有所区分。即是刀工之间所说的「雷电五传」。能锻造名刀的刀工，也被算作是本领通神的神事相关人员，归属统筹文化、艺术、祭祀的社奉行一派管理。因此，出现了刀工背叛的事情，自然就是神里家的督办不力了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Stillness, the Sublimation of Shadow"The art of blade forging taught by the Shogun varies based on astrology, application, materials used, the furnace conditions, individual personalities, and elemental changes. These differences between smiths is what gave rise to the Raiden Gokaden. Swordsmiths capable of forging renowned blades are seen as spiritual personnel with sacred abilities, and as such they should be managed by the Yashiro Commission, which oversees all cultural, artistic, and ceremonial affairs. So naturally, the swordsmith's betrayal is the fault of ineffectual management by the Kamisato Clan.

items.title: 想要了解绫华·其四
items.text: 对我来说，母亲是意义非凡的存在。端庄、优雅，无论遇到怎样的局面都会露出沉静的笑容，以从容不迫的态度，操持着神里家大大小小的事务，说母亲是完美的化身也不为过。但自从她离世的那一刻起，我就深切地意识到，我已经不是那个可以躲在母亲身后的小绫华了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Complete "Stillness, the Sublimation of Shadow"My mother was the most incredible person. She was always so dignified and elegant, always smiling, no matter what situation she might be facing. She had so much to deal with in the clan on so many levels, but she took it all in stride — it was like nothing could ever faze her. Everything about her was perfect, and I say that without exaggerating. *sigh* But the moment she passed away, I realized... I couldn't hide behind my mother any longer. I wasn't little Ayaka any more.

items.title: 想要了解绫华·其五
items.text: 接下来要说的话，可能不太符合「稻妻幕府社奉行神里家」的身份。不过，就我的判断，你应该能容许我小小的任性吧？…稍微有点累了…可以让我靠一下你的肩膀吗？一下就好。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "Stillness, the Sublimation of Shadow"What I want to say next is perhaps not befitting of a member of the Inazuma Shogunate, Yashiro Commission, Kamisato Clan, but... unless I am mistaken, I trust that you will not take issue with this slight departure from convention on my part...That is to say... I'm a little tired, may I rest my head on your shoulder? Just for a moment.

items.title: 绫华的爱好
items.text: 风雅之物我都很喜欢：雅乐诗词、棋艺与舞蹈。你也感兴趣吗？
items.text_en: I have great affection for the arts: music, song, poetry, shougi, and dancing. And you?

items.title: 绫华的烦恼·忧虑
items.text: 烦恼吗？啊，是啊。只要生活在这个世界上，就难免遇到种种不如意的事情。但如果是因为自己的事情，就让周遭的人担心的话…果然，我还是不能说…
items.text_en: Troubles? Well, I mean... that's life, isn't it? There will always be things that don't go one's way. But I do not wish to worry those around me on account of things that are my concern alone... so, it is best if I keep them to myself.

items.title: 绫华的烦恼·心意
items.text: 「坦率」，真的是一件很难的事情。我必须不断告诫自己是神里家的大小姐，在无数双眼睛，无数人的期盼之下摆出完美无缺的姿态。这样的我，是否也该追求自己的愿望呢，是否也该…让你理解我的心意呢…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Openness is something I find very difficult. I constantly have to remind myself that as a lady of the Kamisato Clan, there are countless people watching and countless expectations to live up to. I must be a model of exemplary conduct at all times. But even so, shouldn't I still follow my dreams? Shouldn't I... share my true feelings with you?

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 我对异国料理很有兴趣，虽然很少有尝试的机会。嗯…如果是要局限在稻妻料理内的话…应该是「茶泡饭」吧。不过，不能给一般客人看见，我也是偷偷告诉你的。
items.text_en: I'm fascinated by food from overseas. Though I don't get to try it very often... So, if I had to choose something from Inazuma, then probably... Chazuke. But not when anybody else is watching... So I tell you that in confidence.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 虽然不是不能吃，但我对动物脂肪或内脏大概会有点…
items.text_en: Though I do not eschew animal fat and organs entirely, they are far from my first choice.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 嗯…我真是太幸福了…
items.text_en: Mmm... Yes, I am truly fortunate...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 谢谢你让我有机会尝试这道菜，我会把它的味道记在心里的。
items.text_en: Thank you for the opportunity to try this dish. I will always savor it.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 啊…稍微有点油腻了呢。
items.text_en: Hmm... It's a bit greasy for my taste.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 请随我来！只要走一小段路，不会耽搁你太长时间的哦。打听到你的生日之后，我就提前了一段时间开始筹备。比起名贵的礼物，我妄自猜测…或许这样的礼物会更合我们的情谊。此次，就请让我以扇舞为礼吧。那么，失礼了。
items.text_en: Come with me! We're not going far away — I promise it won't delay you too much.I managed to find out when your birthday was well in advance, so I could prepare in good time. Hopefully this wasn't assuming too much, but I guessed you might prefer this to an expensive gift.In honor of your birthday, please allow me to perform a fan dance for you.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 非常感谢。与你切磋使我受益良多，相信在剑术上也能更进一步。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1Thank you very much. It has been richly rewarding to learn from you so far, and I believe my skills with the blade can go even further still.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 多亏你的点拨。有你相助，我对自己的能力也理解得更透彻了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2Thank you for your guidance. With your assistance, I am gaining a more thorough understanding of my capabilities.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 感觉更加游刃有余了。处理社奉行事务之余，甚至有空尝试一些新的事情。要来试试最近学做的点心吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4I feel more competent now than ever before. I even have the time outside my work for the Yashiro Commission to try some new things. Would you like to try one of my home-made snacks? I just learned how to make them recently.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 「尝有所思，斯世如磐；孰料浮世事，留驻难。」…抱歉，明明是值得高兴的时候，我却想起了那么悲伤的诗歌。和你相处的时间过于畅怀，竟然让我害怕再次失去。真是…失态了呀。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6"Though I cling to that which has given me the strength to hold on, the weight of letting go is ever-foreboding."My apologies, it should be a happy occasion, and yet it is such a sad phrase that comes to mind. Our time together has been so pleasant that I am fearful of losing what I have gained. I'm sorry, I must compose myself.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 起舞吧。
items.text_en: Take flight.

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 失礼了。
items.text_en: My apologies.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 雪纷飞。
items.text_en: Whirling snow.

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: …拿下了！
items.text_en: Embrace the ice.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 樱吹雪。
items.text_en: Sakura swirl.

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 神里流…霜灭！
items.text_en: Kamisato Art: Soumetsu!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 寻珍觅奇…也算得一种雅趣。
items.text_en: Collecting rare and exquisite treasures... Yes, this seems suitably sophisticated.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 呵呵…今日运势不错。
items.text_en: Hehe... Today is a lucky day.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 我会珍惜这一份幸运。
items.text_en: I shall treasure this good fortune.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 不容小觑呢。
items.text_en: I will not stand for this.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 久违的对手…
items.text_en: A worthy opponent...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 该决断了…
items.text_en: We ought to end this!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 不可大意。
items.text_en: Do not overdo it.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 阁下务必小心。
items.text_en: Take care!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 失态了…
items.text_en: Pardon my indiscretion...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 我还有…未竟之事…
items.text_en: Much remains... unfinished...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 让家族…蒙羞了…
items.text_en: I have dishonored... our clan...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 无礼的家伙…
items.text_en: So rude!

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: 怎么会…
items.text_en: Unthinkable...

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 神里绫华，参上。
items.text_en: Kamisato Ayaka, present.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 烦请赐教。
items.text_en: I await your instruction.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 呵呵，请多关照。
items.text_en: A pleasure to be working with you.
